title: Folk Rang by Meghdhanush
label: Meghdhanush
description: A four-track 2018 Meghdhanush EP in the Folk Rang series, catalogued across folk/lokgeet, electronic fusion, traditional Garba and Krishna Garba.
notes: Meghdhanush describes Folk Rang as an experimental Gujarati folk-rock/fusion series sustaining traditional repertoire. Kesariyo Rang is explicitly described by the band as a traditional Garba song for Navratri. The project is included as a folk/fusion branch rather than treating Meghdhanush's unrelated rock catalogue as Garba.
